question: The Indian League was established in 1875 in Calcutta (now Kolkata) by______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sisir Kumar Ghosh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sisir Kumar Ghosh**

 
 
• Sisir Kumar Ghosh was a noted** Indian journalist.**
 
• He was the founder of the **Amrita Bazar Patrika**, a noted Bengali language newspaper in 1868.
 
• He started the** India League** in **1875** with the object of stimulating the sense of nationalism amongst the people.
 
• **Indian League** was associated with nationalist leaders such as **Ananda Mohan Bose, Durgamohan Das, Nabagopal Mitra.**
 
• He published Lord Gauranga or Salvation for All in** 1897.**
 
• He was among the first students to pass Calcutta University's first entrance examination in 1857.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anand Mohan Bose**

 
 
• Ananda Mohan Bose was an Indian politician, academician, social reformer, and lawyer during the British Raj.
 
• He co-founded the** Indian National Association**, one of the earliest Indian political organizations.
 
• In 1874, he became** the first Indian Wrangler** of Cambridge University.
 
• He was also a prominent religious leader of Brahmoism and with Sivanath Sastri a leading light of Adi Dharm.
 
 
 
• **Dwarka Nath Tagore**
 
 
• **​**Dwarkanath Tagore was one of the first **Indian industrialists** to form an enterprise with British partners.
 
• He was the son of Ramlochon Tagore, the founder of the Jorasanko branch of the Tagore family.
 
• He was also the **grandfather of Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
 
 
• **Devendra Nath Tagore**
 
 
• **​**Debendranath Tagore was an Indian **Hindu philosopher** and religious reformer.
 
• He joined** Brahmo samaj** in **1842**.
 
• He was the founder in **1848** of the **Brahmo religion.**
 
 

1a
